svg.title: Li et al. 2001 sonochemical route schematic
svg.desc: Authored source-bound conceptual drawing of a sealed 100 mL reactor in a circulating water bath, 80 percent filled, with a 1.5 cm titanium ultrasonic horn immersed 10 mm. The source reports 20 kHz, 100 W per square centimeter, 3 h and bulk temperature 20 plus or minus 5 Celsius. Geometry, pressure and local cavitation conditions are not measured by this drawing.

g.text: Probe sonication · two separate solvent routes
Ti horn, 1.5 cm; tip 10 mm immersed
Conceptual apparatus only · Li et al. 2001, main pp.1–2 · no source pixels
